label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: A cookie banner and then a newsletter popup with a discount offer were announced on arrival; focus did not move into either, so I had to find the Deny and Close dialog controls myself before I could browse.
The hero slider, category slider and promo bar rotate with many Next slide and Previous slide buttons and groups numbered like 1 / 20, which adds a lot of noise before the products.
Every size radio button is announced twice (for example XS / 36 twice), so I cannot tell which is the real control; the colour swatches are links with only an image name and no chosen state.
After Add to cart the button only said Adding and the cart count stayed at 0; I had to re-read the page to learn the cart drawer had opened, and there was no clear announcement of success.

The checkout page is long and starts with express payment options; the shipping section only says to enter an address, and some images and the sign-in prompt appear before the form, so the order of fields is hard to follow.
